candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization ReadTimeout: traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis succeed, and gateway /v1/checkout p95 is ~2406ms with 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency cause (resource saturation vs network) not established; no payment service metrics/logs admitted.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout errors propagating to order and checkout 502s, with inventory/redis healthy. Gateway metrics confirm elevated checkout latency and 502 rate. Bounded to downstream payment latency; payment-side root cause unconfirmed.
